Subject: Redwood vendor checklist & COI guidance

Jordan / Rafael,

Thanks for sending the docs. I reviewed the COI and W9 quickly. A few items to clear before we move to PO:

1) COI scope: Limits look OK, but we need an Additional Insured endorsement naming Redwood Inference, Inc. (including subsidiaries) on the policy, and the policy must specifically list general liability and professional liability coverage.
2) Retroactive date: for claims-made PL policies, we need retroactive date on or before 2026-01-01. Your COI currently omits the retro date field — can you confirm?
3) Subcontractor disclosure: if NovaProc uses any subcontractors with access to Redwood data, please provide a brief subcontractor list and confirm flow-down requirements.
4) W9: good. Finance needs the tax ID shown on the W9 to match the vendor legal name for PO creation.

If you can upload the endorsement (or a broker letter confirming endorsement is in process) to the portal, we can proceed. I've attached our standard Vendor Onboarding Checklist and the sample endorsement language we require.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf, Redwood_Endorsement_Sample.txt
Upload instructions: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/HS-34567

Best,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
